🕯️ Ursula Toure is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Ursula kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Ursula — and Ursula is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Meera, Donna, Luis and 2 more speak for Gianna — "Ursula trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

That night, they bring Ursula home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (Piper lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Gianna speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
Nikos: "Wild Amaranth is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
Carlos: "Bacaba is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Maya.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
Luis wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what someone said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Gianna goes quiet — and wakes up inside Luis. Gianna never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Luis will never be hungry again while it hums, and Gianna is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🗣️ Piper to Nikos, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
📓 Codex: A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table.

With Haven grieving again, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

🧳 Word of Haven’s new bindings, trade, the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Stonebridge and The Red Table have bound together — Stonebridge primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge and The Red Table bound; Stonebridge primary.
🗣️ Dale to Maya, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
🥣 Amara of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
📓 Codex: Amara of The Red Table begs food at Haven's fire.
